title: Project P.I.T.T. FAST! Achievement — 400/min Peak Production Rate
description: FAST! tracks a 400 products/min Peak Production Rate, not Maw deposits; includes a tested 400/min setup and tips to break the high-300s.
h1: Project P.I.T.T. FAST! Achievement — 400/min Peak Production Rate
quickAnswer: FAST! official Steam condition is 400 products/min; current player-tested evidence indicates the tracked stat is PEAK PRODUCTION RATE, so you must be producing 400 products/min — not depositing 400/min into the Maw; track Peak Production Rate on a Productivity Display when available.

facts.label: Tested route
facts.value: One tested route uses all three max-speed automatic machines + manual Duck production + the x2 crafting-speed buff; a Proxy Intern on the manual Cash Register can add headroom.

facts.label: Common miss
facts.value: Confusing Maw deposit throughput with Peak Production Rate — depositing to the Maw can help lag/performance but is not the unlock condition.
